name: Ooty Special Varkey
description: Traditional layered crispy, flaky Ooty bakery varkey baked fresh with authentic hill-station recipe. Perfect tea-time companion.

name: Ooty Homemade Chocolate
description: Rich artisanal homemade chocolates made with pure cocoa butter, roasted nuts, and velvety smooth milk & dark chocolate.

name: Nilgiri Fresh Tea Powder (Tea Thool)
description: Direct from mist-covered Nilgiri tea estates. High-grown aromatic black tea powder offering strong color and invigorating aroma.

name: Aromatic Roasted Coffee Powder (Coffee Thool)
description: Pure roasted mountain coffee beans ground to perfection. Brews traditional frothy, invigorating South Indian filter coffee.

name: Crispy Bakery Salt Biscuits
description: Golden-baked savory butter crackers sprinkled with light sea salt. Melts in mouth with a savory crunch.
